# [TASK] Add missing Checkstyle/Spotless + dependency/security-scan tooling

## Task
None of DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md's linting/formatting or dependency/security-scan gates have real tooling in this repo yet, discovered auditing Stories #75-#98's Definition of Done claims (2026-08-03) — every closed Story had to leave DoD unchecked because of this gap. Wire up the missing tooling so future work can actually satisfy those gates instead of leaving them permanently unchecked.

## Scope
Java backend: Checkstyle or Spotless, applied repo-wide across all `backend/*` modules. Frontend: make the existing `npm run lint` step in `.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml` actually fail the build instead of falling back to `|| echo "Lint not configured"`. Dependency/security scanning: OWASP Dependency-Check for Gradle modules, `npm audit` (or equivalent) enforced in frontend CI. Does not include retroactively re-running these against all of Sprints 1-6's already-closed work — that stays honestly noted as a gap on those Stories, not backfilled.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Checkstyle or Spotless configured and enforced in CI for all backend modules — Spotless applied repo-wide via the root `subprojects {}` block (build.gradle), `spotlessCheck` wired into `check`, run by `backend-ci.yml`
- [x] Frontend lint step in CI fails the build on lint errors, not just logs them — `npm run lint` in `frontend-ci.yml`, no `|| echo` fallback
- [x] OWASP Dependency-Check (or equivalent) configured and enforced in CI for backend Gradle modules — `dependencyCheckAggregate` runs in `backend-ci.yml`, `failBuildOnCVSS = 9.0`
- [x] npm audit (or equivalent) configured and enforced in frontend CI — `npm audit --audit-level=critical` in `frontend-ci.yml`
- [x] DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md's linting and dependency/security-scan gates are genuinely satisfiable by a Story going forward — DoD's tooling references match what's actually wired up

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
Found during the 2026-08-03 backlog rewrite while auditing Definition of Done claims across all Story issues — see #75's and #77's Notes sections for the discovery. Both dependency/security-scan thresholds (backend and frontend) are deliberately critical-only for now, not tightened yet — tracked separately as #105, not a gap in this issue's scope.
